USURER-INFERNAL_LEDGER.title: Infernal Ledger
USURER-INFERNAL_LEDGER.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Borrow[/gold] [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold] (+[blue]5[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]). The first time each combat you become [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold] ([blue]10+[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]) or reduce your [gold]Debt[/gold] to [blue]0[/blue], gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw [blue]1[/blue] card. Unpaid [gold]Debt[/gold] is settled from your [gold]Gold[/gold] after combat.
USURER-INFERNAL_LEDGER.flavor: Its pages burn with names that have been dead for centuries, yet the interest still compounds.
USURER-ABACUS_OF_GREED.title: Abacus of Greed
USURER-ABACUS_OF_GREED.description: Whenever an enemy dies while it has [gold]Lien[/gold], transfer its [gold]Lien[/gold] to a random living enemy, forgive [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold], and gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
USURER-ABACUS_OF_GREED.flavor: Every bead is carved from a debtor's knucklebone.
USURER-BLOOD_SIGNET.title: Blood Signet
USURER-BLOOD_SIGNET.description: At the start of your turn, if you are [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold] ([blue]10+[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]), gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Lien[/gold] to ALL enemies.
USURER-BLOOD_SIGNET.flavor: Pressed into hot crimson wax, it binds flesh and fortune alike.
